lines.speaker: Наратор
lines.text: (The Janitor looks you over, then leans in with a half-smirk.)

lines.speaker: Домар
lines.text: You’re not here by accident, are you?

lines.speaker: Наратор
lines.text: (He wipes his hands and pulls out a folded paper.)

lines.speaker: Домар
lines.text: About those Exams on Friday. I’ve got the answers — straight from the teacher’s stash.

lines.speaker: Домар
lines.text: But I don’t sell to people who don’t know what they need.
